blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Fleetwood Tynehead?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 137 houses listed in Fleetwood Tynehead. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Fleetwood Tynehead a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Fleetwood Tynehead had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Fleetwood Tynehead from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 51 houses sold in Fleetwood Tynehead over those 4 months, out of 351 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Fleetwood Tynehead?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
